comparison: Exact parsed JSON with sorted-object canonicalization; arrays/order/values retained; no serializer-default/tag/unification equivalence invented.
hash_manifest_format: SHA256 of canonical JSON array rows {recipe_id,source_canonical_sha256,export_canonical_sha256} sorted by recipe_id. Raw and canonical SHA perfile below; no duplicate raw recipe payloads.
interpretation: Matching source version and canonical recipe matches support source/export structural comparison, not proof of installed binary→commit identity.
Different canonical JSON can reflect serializer defaults, unification, pack modifications or implementation drift. No blanket claim that all differences are broken recipes or exploits.
Installed exported recipes remain authoritative for recipe IDs/formats currently available to this project.
